name: Trim Stain Prep — Template (SF)
intent: Canonical bare-wood stain prep for SF substrates — wainscot, wood wall, wood ceiling. Same shape as the LF template, just SF universal keepers.
doctrine: SF parallel to MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_PREP_STAIN_LF. Used by MOD_PREP_WAINSCOT_STAIN / MOD_PREP_WOOD_WALL_STAIN / MOD_PREP_WOOD_CEILING_STAIN. Ceiling-substrate modules add modifier_eligibility.overhead:true for TRADE_OVERHEAD.
